title: What If Everyone Got Free Money? Finland Tried It

scenes.text: What if the government paid you 560 euros a month, no strings? Finland tried it.
In 2017, 2,000 unemployed people were picked at random to get that money for two years.
It was tax-free, and they kept it even if they found a job.
Employment barely moved. In the study year, recipients worked an average of six more days.
But recipients reported more life satisfaction and less depression, stress and loneliness.
So the money bought less a job than a calmer mind.
